headline.title: Create, edit and star in videos with two Google Vids updates
headline.summary: Google has introduced two updates to its Google Vids platform: Gemini Omni, which enhances video creation and editing capabilities, and Personal Avatars, allowing users to star in their own videos. These features aim to improve user engagement and personalization in video content creation.

articles.title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Embed Ranks #1 Overall on RTEB, Advancing Agentic Retrieval
articles.summary: NVIDIA's Nemotron 3 Embed has achieved the top ranking on the Retrieval Benchmark (RTEB), marking a significant advancement in agentic retrieval technology. This development highlights NVIDIA's ongoing efforts to enhance AI capabilities in information retrieval systems.

articles.title: The agent security gap: 54% of enterprises have already had an AI agent incident, and most still let agents share credentials
articles.summary: A recent study of 107 enterprises reveals that 54% have experienced an AI agent security incident, with many still allowing agents to share credentials and lacking adequate controls. Only about one-third of organizations assign scoped identities to each agent, and just 30% isolate their highest-risk agents, highlighting significant security gaps in AI deployment.

articles.title: Why teens deserve access to safe AI
articles.summary: OpenAI is enhancing ChatGPT to ensure it is safe for teenagers by implementing age-appropriate protections, educational tools, and parental controls. The initiative includes collaborations with experts to create a secure environment for young users.

articles.title: Connect more of your apps to Search
articles.summary: The article discusses the introduction of connected apps that enhance search functionality by integrating various applications. This feature aims to improve user experience by allowing seamless access to information across multiple platforms.

articles.title: New York governor says she’s using AI to analyze ‘every single rule’ in the state
articles.summary: New York Governor Kathy Hochul announced that her administration is utilizing AI to review all state rules, regulations, and policies for potential updates. This initiative comes alongside her recent decision to impose a moratorium on new AI data centers in the state.

articles.title: Roblox launches an AI-powered game-creation feature in its mobile app
articles.summary: Roblox has introduced a new "Build" feature in its mobile app that allows users to create basic games by inputting a single text prompt. This AI-powered tool aims to simplify the game creation process for users.

articles.title: How a former DeepMind researcher raised at a $300M pre-seed valuation before launching a product
articles.summary: Former DeepMind researcher Andrew Dai has raised $300 million in pre-seed funding to explore advancements in visual AI, leveraging his extensive experience in developing influential AI systems. Dai's work includes contributions to research that informed the creation of ChatGPT, highlighting his expertise in the field.

articles.title: Moonshot’s upcoming Kimi 3 is expected to close the gap with Anthropic’s Opus 4.8
articles.summary: Moonshot's Kimi 3 is set to be the largest open AI model from China, featuring a parameter count between 2 trillion and 3 trillion. This development aims to narrow the competitive gap with Anthropic's Opus 4.8.

articles.title: Here’s Why Anthropic Is Pushing States to Regulate AI Faster
articles.summary: Anthropic is advocating for faster regulation of AI, citing that existing transparency laws in California and New York may already be outdated. The company's head of US state and local policy emphasizes the need for updated frameworks to keep pace with rapid advancements in AI technology.

articles.title: Claude can now use your 1Password credentials for you
articles.summary: 1Password has introduced a new browser integration for the Anthropic chatbot Claude, enabling it to access users' stored security credentials such as usernames and passwords. This feature allows Claude to perform multi-step tasks like booking travel and managing online accounts on behalf of users without manual login input.

articles.title: Google’s AI Mode now lets you link and interact with select apps
articles.summary: Google has updated its AI Mode to allow users to link and interact with select applications, enhancing its functionality beyond just answering questions. This expansion aims to facilitate task completion within frequently used apps.
